Code for measuring the number of wins, ties and losses across HumanEval Samples between CFG (\gamma=1.25) and no CFG (\gamma=1) has been implemented for CodeGen-350M-mono for temperatures 0.2, 0.6, 0.8 has been implemented. A win is when CFG answers a sample correctly while no CFG does not, a loss is the reciprocal case, and a tie is when CFG and no CFG both get the sample correct or both get the sample incorrect.
